messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: sudden uptick in 5xxs and p95/p99 on /v1/chat.complete starting ~1830000000. Error rate jumped from 0.1% to ~7% and p99 latency up to ~2.8s. Paging oncall.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-1830000001. Severity: P1. Pager: @Elena. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-p1
Elena: I
m oncall. Pulling live metrics and active deploys. Anyone pushed config or runtime in the last 20m?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: adaptive-batching-v1 @ 183000 - targets: 25% traffic. Also deployed quant-profiler int8-experiment at 1829999950.
Nina: I see traffic routed to canary. Initial flamegraphs show longer kernel stall times during large-batch workloads. Also seeing more prefix-cache evictions around that timeframe.
Jordan: Running live traces for failing requests now. Notable pattern: several big requests (seq_len>2500) are being coalesced into huge batches and causing long GPU exec plus occasional OOM_recover.
CS-Liam: Customer impact: Tenant "MapleApps" saw a surge of 503s for ~8 minutes and created a support case. They indicated user-facing errors for an important workflow.
Elena: Hypotheses:
- H1: adaptive-batching-v1 increases batch coalescing window -> larger batches under bursty seq_len distribution -> p99 regressions/ooms.
- H2: int8-quant profiler change accidentally changed execution kernel selection -> slower on some paths.
- H3: cache TTL tweak in the canary evicting useful KV prefixes causing recompute churn.
- H4: unrelated scaling event causing backend throttling.
Ravi: Can we get a quick sample of failing request logs and memory footprints? Need to know if OOMs or timeouts are primary.
Jordan: Pasting sanitized samples:
```
[1830000023] req=xy1 tenant=MapleApps seq=3072 batch=56 queue_ms=1800 gpu_ms=2100 status=500 error=OOM_recover
[1830000025] req=xy2 tenant=OtherCo seq=128 batch=1 queue_ms=12 gpu_ms=16 status=200
[1830000030] req=xy3 tenant=MapleApps seq=2048 batch=40 queue_ms=1400 gpu_ms=1700 status=500 error=timeout
```
Looks like both long exec times and memory pressure.
Nina: Quick telemetry: prefix-cache eviction rate + cache miss ratio rose sharply at canary start. That supports H3 contributing to more GPU work.
Elena: Immediate mitigations (aim for minimal blast radius):
- Mit A (scoped): rollback adaptive-batching to previous config on canary only.
- Mit B (scoped): disable int8-experiment on canary.
- Mit C: apply token-cap per-tenant for affected Dedicateds and route them to latency-optimized variant.
- Mit D: emergency scale-up of GPU pool for 30m to absorb backlog (costly).
Ravi: Prioritize A+B since they're low-change and target the canary. Jordan/Nina, can you prepare CLI commands? Ian take C if needed for tenants.
Jordan: Patch for A: `kubectl patch cm inference-batching -n prod -p '{"data":{"adaptive_window_ms":"12"}}'` to shrink coalescing window to pre-canary value. Istimate ~90s for change propagation to canary nodes.
Nina: Patch for B: `deployctl disable --experiment int8-quant --scope canary`. I'll run that and watch for kernel selection falling back.
CS-Liam: Applying token-cap C for MapleApps would help them immediately if A/B take too long. I can request tenant-level cap via route change.
Elena: Assignments: Jordan -> Mit A rollback, Nina -> Mit B disable, Ravi -> Mit C tenant cap + customer comms. I'll monitor and coordinate.
incident-bot: Actions recorded: Mit A assigned to Jordan, Mit B to Nina, Mit C to Ravi. ENG-SRE alerted for standby.
Jordan: Executing Mit A now. `kubectl patch` applied at 1830000145. Observability: avg batch size on canary dropped ~28% in ~60s.
Nina: Disabling int8 experiment at 1830000160. Kernel selection reverted for canary traffic. Watching perf.
Ravi: Applied tenant cap and pinned MapleApps to variant=latency-safe at 1830000180 via `redwoodctl routing set --tenant MapleApps --model-variant=latency-safe --max-tokens=2048`.
Jordan: Early numbers: queue_ms p95 dropped from 1100ms to 320ms for sampled heavy requests. Error rate trending down.
Nina: Kernel stall metrics decreased after int8 revert; seems int8 path was sometimes falling back to slow path for specific ops. That likely amplified the batching effect.
Elena: Monitoring for 20 minutes. If stable, move incident to MONITORING and create RCA ticket. If not, plan for Mit D (scale-up) or full runtime rollback to previous release (revert to runtime-v2.3).
CS-Liam: MapleApps reports errors cleared. They appreciate the quick cap and routing change.
Jordan: For RCA we need to collect: canary deploy diff for adaptive-batching-v1, int8 experiment config, kernel selection logs, per-batch mem usage, and cache eviction traces. I'll bundle and upload to GH issue.
Nina: Experiment repro note: adaptive batching appears fine for typical seq distributions but interacts poorly with int8 kernel selection + high seq lengths. We'll need an integration perf test.
Ravi: Post-incident actions (PIAs):
- PIA-1: require perf gate for adaptive-batching changes with end-to-end large-seq synthetic (owner: Engineering-ML / Nina).
- PIA-2: add canary guardrail that limits max batch size and per-batch mem when adaptive-batching enabled (owner: Infra / Jordan).
- PIA-3: surface experiment rollouts centrally with explicit kernel-impact notes and rollback playbook (owner: Product Ops).
All agreed?
Elena: Agreed. I'll create follow-up tasks and assign them in the incident board.
incident-bot: Incident INC-1830000001 moved to MONITORING at 1830000365. Follow-up tasks and RCA issue created.
Ravi: Drafting a customer timeline and mitigation summary for Sales/AMs. Will post links to RCA doc and GH traces here when ready. Thanks team; leaving thread open for artifacts.
(End of thread)
